## 🛒 Something Went Wrong — store health (`medusa-backend`)
Every tile below is the raw telemetry behind an incident: the failing spans the explainer agent investigates. Queries follow the dashboard timeframe.

1.title: Failed operations
1.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "medusa-backend" and span.status_code == "error"
| summarize failures = count()

2.title: Failures over time
2.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "medusa-backend" and span.status_code == "error"
| makeTimeseries failures = count(), time: start_time, interval: 30m

3.title: Top failing operations
3.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "medusa-backend" and span.status_code == "error"
| summarize failures = count(), by: { span.name }
| sort failures desc
| limit 10

4.title: Recent failures (exception + trace id)
4.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "medusa-backend" and span.status_code == "error"
| expand span.events
| fieldsAdd exception_type = span.events[`exception.type`], exception_message = span.events[`exception.message`]
| filter isNotNull(exception_message)
| fields start_time, span.name, exception_type, exception_message, trace.id
| sort start_time desc
| limit 50

5.title: Store API latency p95 (ms)
5.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "medusa-backend" and startsWith(span.name, "/store")
| makeTimeseries p95_ms = percentile(toDouble(duration) / 1000000, 95), time: start_time, interval: 30m

6.content:
## 🤖 Explainer agent (`explainer-agent`)
The agent that investigates the failures above — observed by the same tenant it queries. `incident.phase` A = preliminary (no tools), B = confirmed (DQL investigation). Joinable to store traces via `incident.store_trace_id`.

7.title: Explanations produced
7.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "explainer-agent" and span.name == "explain_incident"
| summarize explanations = count()

8.title: Time to explanation by phase (s)
8.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "explainer-agent" and span.name == "explain_incident"
| fieldsAdd seconds = toDouble(duration) / 1000000000
| summarize avg_s = avg(seconds), max_s = max(seconds), runs = count(), by: { incident.phase }
| sort incident.phase asc

9.title: Gemini token usage
9.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "explainer-agent" and isNotNull(`gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`)
| summarize input_tokens = sum(`gen_ai.usage.input_tokens`), output_tokens = sum(`gen_ai.usage.output_tokens`), llm_calls = count()

10.title: Agent tool calls
10.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "explainer-agent" and startsWith(span.name, "execute_tool")
| summarize calls = count(), by: { span.name }
| sort calls desc

11.title: Recent agent runs
11.query:
fetch spans
| filter service.name == "explainer-agent" and span.name == "explain_incident"
| fieldsAdd seconds = toDouble(duration) / 1000000000
| fields start_time, incident.id, incident.phase, seconds, incident.store_trace_id, trace.id
| sort start_time desc
| limit 50
